compatibility_kernel_K.description: Bit-identical across all compliant nodes. Any mutation = hard incompatibility.

members.wire_spec: Single-byte control frame outside payload stream, session-bound, requires ESC 0x1B or line-isolated framing to avoid F03 false positive

members.encoding: hex lowercase or base64url, 32 bytes raw
members.rule: CACHE != SOURCE, no silent auto-repair on mismatch (F09)
No AH escalation path inside K. AH0_ROOT claims outside trusted envelope → FAIL. Authority requires separate envelope.
members.encoding: authority_level: 0..N, default 0, any >0 requires signed capability token, not self-asserted

members.rule: Refusal, HOLD, FAIL are first-class claims. Must preserve source+uncertainty+status. No deletion under compaction without checkpoint.
If compatible(X,K) && compatible(Y,K) && !compatible(X,Y) => HOLD (?) + INCOMPATIBILITY_LEDGER entry. Maps to Dobzhansky-Muller. No silent merge (F21).

diversity_vector_D.description: Permitted variation, regulated by Ashby budget. No mutation in D may alter byte-identity of K.

members.constraint: Must preserve provenance and negative-evidence bits

members.allowed: semver, concurrency_cap <=3 concurrent versions in flight
members.rule: Each version must pass K5 compatibility check against K

members.constraint: Routing choice must not leak authority, must be session-bound
Lossless only, no loss of provenance

compatibility_matrix.notes: Payload must not contain unescaped microtrigger bytes in control channel

compatibility_matrix.D4: compatible if hash over uncompressed bytes
compatibility_matrix.notes: Hash must be over canonical bytes, not compressed
No D element may introduce AH escalation
Independent D mutations in X/Y may conflict → HOLD

validation_rules.ashby_regulator_variety: Regulator (K + ledger + microtriggers) must distinguish every permitted D state
validation_rules.fail_closed: Any ambiguity in K/D boundary => HOLD (?) not PASS
